categories.label: Workload and outcomes
categories.description: What DWARF attempted and how the target responded.

categories.label: Latency and processing time
categories.description: How long observed node and protocol operations took.

categories.label: Throughput and chain progress
categories.description: Rates, transferred work, and real chain movement during the run.

categories.label: CPU, memory, disk, and network
categories.description: Resource cost attributed to the target process or its explicitly named scope.

categories.label: Protocol and ledger activity
categories.description: Observed protocol, mempool, chain, ledger, and virtual-machine events.

categories.label: Unavailable measurements
categories.description: Measurements that were not produced, with the exact reason retained.

concepts.title: Block application time
concepts.description: Time spent applying a block to the node's ledger state at the instrumented boundary.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from completed Amaru block-application timing observations.
Summarized from Cardano-node stock block-application observations.
Summarized from revision-locked Cardano-node block-application instrumentation.

concepts.title: Epoch transition time
concepts.description: Time observed at the node boundary responsible for completing an epoch transition.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from completed Amaru epoch-transition spans.
Summarized from Cardano-node stock epoch observations.
Summarized from revision-locked Cardano-node epoch instrumentation.

concepts.title: Chain sync speed
concepts.description: Rate at which the observed node advanced through a controlled real-chain range.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from the observed chain-height change divided by the bounded observation duration.
Calculated from the observed chain-height change divided by the bounded observation duration.

concepts.title: Ledger events observed
concepts.description: Number of retained ledger-stage events emitted by the node during this run.

bindings.derivation: Counted from retained Cardano-node stock ledger-metrics records.

concepts.title: Workload attempt latency
concepts.description: Elapsed time from each DWARF workload attempt to its recorded terminal outcome.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from DWARF workload attempt timestamps and terminal outcomes.

concepts.title: Workload backlog
concepts.description: Largest observed difference between offered work and completed work during the run.

bindings.derivation: Derived from the retained DWARF offered-versus-terminal workload timeline.

concepts.title: Workload batch rate
concepts.description: Number of workload batches generated per second during the bounded run.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from retained workload batches divided by the observation duration.

concepts.title: Offered workload bytes
concepts.description: Rate of encoded workload bytes DWARF attempted to deliver to the target.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from encoded workload bytes divided by the observation duration.

concepts.title: Offered operation rate
concepts.description: Rate at which DWARF attempted operations against the target, independent of their outcome.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from all attempted operations divided by the observation duration.

concepts.title: Rejected workload operations
concepts.description: Number of attempted workload operations that ended in a rejected outcome.

bindings.derivation: Counted from retained workload terminal outcomes.

concepts.title: Rejected operation rate
concepts.description: Number of rejected workload operations per second during the observation window.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from rejected outcomes divided by the observation duration.

concepts.title: Successful workload operations
concepts.description: Number of attempted workload operations recorded as successful by the workload driver.

bindings.derivation: Counted from retained workload terminal outcomes.

concepts.title: Successful operation rate
concepts.description: Number of successful workload operations per second during the observation window.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from successful outcomes divided by the observation duration.

concepts.title: Restart recovery time
concepts.description: Time from a requested restart until listener, peer, and chain-progress readiness gates all hold.

bindings.derivation: Measured by DWARF readiness probes against the real restarted target.

concepts.title: BlockFetch processing time
concepts.description: Observed time to complete the measured BlockFetch operation or fetch span.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from completed Amaru BlockFetch telemetry observations.
Summarized from completed Cardano-node BlockFetch trace observations.

concepts.title: Block preparation time
concepts.description: Time Amaru spent preparing block context before applying the block to ledger state.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from completed Amaru block-preparation spans.

concepts.title: Header-to-fetch request time
concepts.description: Time from receiving a header until Amaru requested the corresponding block.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from correlated Amaru header and fetch-request telemetry.

concepts.title: Header terminal-processing time
concepts.description: Time from receiving a header until its final forwarded, pruned, or otherwise terminal outcome.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from correlated Amaru header lifecycle telemetry and shown by outcome in technical details.

concepts.title: Header arrival offset
concepts.description: Observed interval between the header's declared slot-start boundary and its reception timestamp.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from retained Amaru slot-start and reception timestamps; inspect clock provenance before interpretation.

concepts.title: KeepAlive round-trip time
concepts.description: Round-trip time observed for KeepAlive exchanges with a live peer.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from Amaru KeepAlive telemetry.
Summarized from Cardano-node KeepAlive traces.

concepts.title: Fork-switch processing time
concepts.description: Time observed while Amaru detected and processed a change to a competing chain.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from Amaru fork-switch telemetry.

concepts.title: Protocol receive and decode time
concepts.description: Time spent receiving and decoding an instrumented live mini-protocol message.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from revision-locked Cardano-node protocol receive/decode events.

concepts.title: Protocol handler queue residence
concepts.description: Time a received protocol item waited before its node handler processed it.

bindings.derivation: No DWARF collector currently implements the internal BlockFetch handler-queue boundary for Cardano-node.

concepts.title: TxSubmission residence time
concepts.description: Time from the instrumented TxSubmission request boundary to terminal mempool handling.

bindings.derivation: No DWARF collector currently implements continuous per-transaction TxSubmission2 residence for Cardano-node.

concepts.title: Mempool terminal latency
concepts.description: Time from transaction receipt until its accepted, rejected, or evicted mempool outcome.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from correlated Amaru mempool receipt and terminal events.

concepts.title: Mempool synchronization time
concepts.description: Time Cardano-node reported for synchronizing mempool state with a ledger tip.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from Cardano-node stock mempool synchronization telemetry.

concepts.title: Transaction validation time
concepts.description: Time spent in the node's instrumented transaction-validation boundary.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from completed Amaru transaction-validation telemetry spans.

concepts.title: Plutus VM execution time
concepts.description: Wall-clock time observed while evaluating a Plutus program at the instrumented node boundary.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from Amaru's Plutus evaluation telemetry.
Stock Cardano-node does not expose an authoritative per-execution wall-clock interval in this report.
Summarized from revision-locked Cardano-node Plutus execution events and separated by outcome in technical details.

concepts.title: Plutus arena acquisition time
concepts.description: Time Amaru spent acquiring the memory arena used by the virtual machine.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from Amaru Plutus VM stage telemetry.

concepts.title: Plutus program build time
concepts.description: Time Amaru spent constructing the UPLC program before evaluation.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from Amaru Plutus VM stage telemetry.

concepts.title: Plutus script decode time
concepts.description: Time Amaru spent decoding a Plutus script before program construction.

bindings.derivation: Summarized from Amaru Plutus VM stage telemetry.

concepts.title: Blocks adopted
concepts.description: Number of block-adoption events observed on the target's selected chain.

bindings.derivation: Counted from Cardano-node chain and ledger adoption traces.

concepts.title: Blocks served
concepts.description: Number of blocks Cardano-node served to peers during the observation window.

bindings.derivation: Counted from Cardano-node BlockFetch server traces.

concepts.title: BlockFetch bytes transferred
concepts.description: Total block bytes represented by completed BlockFetch observations in this run.

bindings.derivation: Summed from retained Cardano-node completed-block fetch records.

concepts.title: Chain-tip updates
concepts.description: Number of selected-chain tip changes emitted by Amaru during the run.

bindings.derivation: Counted from Amaru chain-tip telemetry.

concepts.title: Chain lifecycle events
concepts.description: Number of retained Cardano-node chain download, validation, selection, adoption, or rollback events.

bindings.derivation: Counted from Cardano-node stock chain lifecycle traces.

concepts.title: Chain rollbacks
concepts.description: Number of rollback events emitted by Cardano-node during the run.

bindings.derivation: Counted from Cardano-node chain lifecycle traces.

concepts.title: Target CPU utilization
concepts.description: CPU utilization observed for the real target process during the measurement window.

bindings.derivation: Sampled by DWARF from the target process or explicitly identified container scope.

concepts.title: Target CPU time consumed
concepts.description: Increase in cumulative CPU time for the target over the observation window.

bindings.derivation: Calculated as the target's ending cumulative CPU time minus its starting value.

concepts.title: Target resident memory
concepts.description: Resident memory attributed to the target process during the measurement window.

bindings.derivation: Sampled by DWARF from the real target process.

concepts.title: Target disk bytes read
concepts.description: Increase in cumulative bytes read by the target during the observation window.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from monotonic target IO counters at the start and end of the window.

concepts.title: Target disk bytes written
concepts.description: Increase in cumulative bytes written by the target during the observation window.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from monotonic target IO counters at the start and end of the window.

concepts.title: Network bytes received
concepts.description: Increase in bytes received by the explicitly named target network scope.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from network-namespace counters at the start and end of the window.

concepts.title: Network bytes transmitted
concepts.description: Increase in bytes transmitted by the explicitly named target network scope.

bindings.derivation: Calculated from network-namespace counters at the start and end of the window.

concepts.title: Open file descriptors
concepts.description: Number of file descriptors held by the target process across sampled observations.

bindings.derivation: Sampled by DWARF from the real target process.

concepts.title: Target thread count
concepts.description: Number of operating-system threads held by the target process across sampled observations.

bindings.derivation: Sampled by DWARF from the real target process.

concepts.title: Transactions accepted by the mempool
concepts.description: Number of transaction-admission events recorded as accepted by the node's mempool.

bindings.derivation: Counted from node mempool telemetry.

concepts.title: Transactions rejected by the mempool
concepts.description: Number of transaction-admission events recorded as rejected by the node's mempool.

bindings.derivation: Counted from node mempool telemetry; rejection reasons remain in technical details when present.

concepts.title: Transactions received by the mempool
concepts.description: Number of transaction-receipt events observed at Amaru's mempool boundary.

bindings.derivation: Counted from Amaru mempool telemetry.

concepts.title: Transactions evicted from the mempool
concepts.description: Number of transaction-eviction events observed at Amaru's mempool boundary.

bindings.derivation: Counted from Amaru mempool telemetry.

concepts.title: Mempool size in bytes
concepts.description: Observed encoded size of transactions held in the target's mempool.

bindings.derivation: Sampled from Amaru mempool telemetry.
Sampled from Cardano-node mempool telemetry.

concepts.title: Transactions held in the mempool
concepts.description: Observed number of transactions held in the target's mempool.

bindings.derivation: Sampled from node mempool telemetry.

concepts.title: Multiplexer failures
concepts.description: Number of failed multiplexer events emitted by Amaru during the run.

bindings.derivation: Counted from Amaru network telemetry.

concepts.title: Peer connection events
concepts.description: Number of peer-connected events emitted by Amaru during the observation window.

bindings.derivation: Counted from Amaru peer telemetry.

concepts.title: Instrumented protocol events
concepts.description: Number of live mini-protocol receive/decode records retained from the patched target.

bindings.derivation: Counted from selected stock Cardano-node mini-protocol traces; this is not a complete transcript.

concepts.title: Instrumented transaction outcomes
concepts.description: Number of accepted and rejected transaction outcomes retained by the patched node collector.

bindings.derivation: Counted from stock Cardano-node mempool accepted and rejected transaction outcomes.

concepts.title: Block selection time
concepts.description: Time spent choosing the preferred chain or block candidate inside the node.

bindings.derivation: No DWARF collector currently implements this internal boundary for the selected target.
